State_change_caption: The tortilla undergoes a noticeable transition across the three frames, driven by the careful manipulation of the hand. Initially presented as a flat, supple disc, it begins a journey back to its pack, its shape and texture remaining relatively intact. As the motion progresses, the tortilla succumbs to the forces exerted by the hand and gravity, bending and folding, altering its form. This evolution from a flat entity to a conforming, folded object encapsulates a simple, yet precise action of returning the tortilla to its storage, a mundane task executed with an everyday grace and necessity.
